Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation match the results originally recorded in the code implementation. Self-evaluation results (Precision=63.89%, Recall=89.84%, F1=74.68%) exactly match Table 2. Proxy-based evaluation results (Precision=62.90%, Recall=93.98%, F1=75.36%) exactly match Table 2. Data statistics (7,799 span-level samples with 4,406 negative and 3,393 positive) match the documentation.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All steps in the final plan are reflected in the implementation: (1) ECS computation per attention head/layer using cosine similarity is implemented in compute_scores.py, (2) PKS computation per FFN layer using Jensen-Shannon divergence is implemented, (3) TransformerLens library with Qwen3-0.6b (28 layers, 16 heads, 476 features) is used, (4) All four classifiers (LR, SVC, Random Forest, XGBoost) are trained in classifier.py, (5) Both self-evaluation and proxy-based evaluation settings are tested with corresponding test datasets.
Rationale.CS3_Effect_Size: The reported effects have clearly non-trivial magnitudes: (1) Classification F1 improvements of 7-17 percentage points over weaker baselines (TruLens: +7.36pp, llama-3.1-8b: +17.15pp), (2) ECS Cohen's d = 0.608 (medium effect), (3) PKS Cohen's d = 0.574 (medium effect), (4) Correlations are statistically significant with r=-0.29 for ECS and r=+0.28 for PKS (both p<0.001).
Rationale.CS4_Justification: All key design choices are explicitly justified: (1) Qwen3-0.6b selection for efficiency and TransformerLens compatibility (Section 1, 3.1), (2) ECS metric with mechanistic explanation of attention heads (Section 3.2, Figure 2), (3) PKS metric with FFN contribution explanation (Section 3.2, Figure 3), (4) SVC classifier selection based on highest validation F1 (Table 1), (5) Feature selection using SmartCorrelatedSelection (Appendix C), (6) Span-level to response-level aggregation (Section 3.3). Conclusions follow from presented evidence with correlation analysis.
Rationale.CS5_Statistical_Significance: FAIL: The documentation reports key experimental results without appropriate measures of uncertainty or statistical significance. Missing elements include: (1) No p-values reported for correlation analyses (Figures 2b, 3b), (2) No confidence intervals for precision, recall, F1 metrics (Tables 1, 2), (3) No standard deviations or error bars on performance metrics, (4) No statistical tests comparing classifier performance or baseline methods, (5) No cross-validation results to assess variability. While sample sizes are reported and correlations are visualized, results are presented as point estimates only.
